lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
recommendations-dashboard: 929 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/vue 412 B, generated by rollup 197 B, generated by vite 190 B.
recommendations-main: 68 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 68 B.
All 2 pages load the same 1 file: 267,554 B raw, 91,391 B gzip, 91.3 % of the smallest page (recommendations-main, 293,084 B).
Inside: axios 129,632 B, dompurify 50,121 B, generated by vite 39,697 B, @nextcloud/vue 22,842 B, @nextcloud/logger 9,788 B.
9,051 B in 165 pieces of 5 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
recommendations-main.mjs at byte 3,067, 251 B, after ../node_modules/@nextcloud/files/dist/ui/headers/listHeaders.mjs: "order:90,enabled(e,t){return t.id===\"files\"&&e.path===\"/\"},r"
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (73 packages, 217 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
